item.title: Researchers Use Light to Study Electron Motion in Wigner Crystals
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – The group of BQC Prof. Tomasz Smoleński at the University of Basel, together with researchers from the Technical University of Munich, has found a new way to observe the collective motion of electrons in one of the most elusive states of matter: the Wigner crystal.
